column1: # Key K3f: numerical cipher of the Spanish embassy at Genoa, 1638 (Velasco y la Cueva / Medina de las Torres).
# Columns: token, value, flag (O = observed in an aligned cipher/plain pair; S = structural fill from its series of five).
# Rebuilt step by step on AGS EST,LEG,3594,146 / 145, 143 / 142 and 169 / 168 (cipher / contemporary plain copy).
# Frozen (SHA-256 b0b4d5c9...) before the final held-out test: 3594,160 (19 lines, transcription frozen before its
# plain copy 3594,159 was opened): 0.896 of characters / 0.784 of words, 200 permuted-value control keys p99 0.343 / 0.204.
# Transcription conventions: ß = n-like sign; Ɉ = large J; E = epsilon-like sign; x = alpha-like sign; in the second hand
# (156, 158, 160) tall long-s = m (s), small loop = l (a); "r" = separator mark at the start/end of the cipher.
# addition after the test (alignment 160 / 159): "-M- 41 hnf" = "la gente de vuestra magestad"
